service.description: Home's service measures for the user's scope over a period (the last 30 days by default): open, overdue, unassigned, SLA compliance, first response, resolution and CSAT, each with its label, value text (null where not configured), whether it is configured, its denominator and the change against the previous period of the same length; the period and the time they were read; and which of Home's panels the user's role sees (my cases, team queues, returns awaiting approval, approvals waiting). Refuses a user without Customer Service.

parameter.name: measures
parameter.description: Each measure's key, label, icon, configured, valueText, denominatorText and changeText.

parameter.name: panels
parameter.description: myCases, teamQueues, awaitingReturns and approvalsWaiting: whether the user's role sees the panel (design §1).

parameter.name: splitRows
parameter.description: P14: for a user who works cases in queues, the measures with their myText (the user's own cases) and teamText (their queues and cases).

set.from: ec.l10n.format(periodStart, 'd MMM yyyy') + ' – ' + ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'd MMM yyyy')

[ {key: 'open', label: 'Open', icon: 'sym_o_inbox'}, {key: 'overdue', label: 'Overdue', icon: 'sym_o_schedule'}, {key: 'unassigned', label: 'Unassigned', icon: 'sym_o_person_off'}, {key: 'slaCompliance', label: 'SLA compliance', icon: 'sym_o_verified'}, {key: 'firstResponse', label: 'First response', icon: 'sym_o_reply'}, {key: 'resolution', label: 'Resolution', icon: 'sym_o_task_alt'}, {key: 'csat', label: 'CSAT', icon: 'sym_o_sentiment_satisfied'} ].map((measure) => Object.assign(measure, {configured: false, valueText: null, denominatorText: null, changeText: null}))

service.description: The filters the Customer Service reports share: the organization (one of the user's; empty, every one), the queue and team (among those the user reports on), the period (from and through days in the user's zone; the last 30 days, 90 for returns, by default), an as-of time (now by default; an earlier one reads the facts recorded by then), the grouping, and output csv for the export.

The reports Customer Service owns that the user may read (design §7 ReportCatalogue), each in Insights' catalog contract (entry id, the owner app, title, description, route, parameters, export): the Reports area's grant, SatisfactionResults for service management (SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE). Refuses a user without Customer Service.

Service level compliance (design §7 ServiceLevelCompliance) of the clocks started in the period, each as it stood at the as-of time, by queue, team, priority band, policy row and calendar, channel or clock: counted, met, missed, closed without it, open past due, open within target, the rate (met over the decided and the open past due, so an open case past due counts against it) with its denominator, cancelled apart (never in the rate), and the paused business time; never a clock a merge ended (its carried copy on the kept case counts, F137). Refuses PERMISSION_DENIED (no Reports), RECORD_UNAVAILABLE (another's organization, queue or team) and PERIOD_INVALID.

Response times (design §7 ResponseTimes) of first response (an outward response the channel accepted) or resolution (each episode, a reopen its own) done in the period: count, median, p90 and mean in business time (the clock's calendar less its pauses) and elapsed time, with the clocks still open at the as-of time and their median age, by queue, team, priority band or channel. Refuses as get#SlaCompliance.

Case volumes (design §7 CaseVolumes) in the period by queue, team, type, channel, day, week or month: received (a merged case's intake kept), of which split off another case, resolved, reopened, cancelled and merged (apart), assignments, and the backlog open at the as-of time, where a merged case is not counted again. Refuses as get#SlaCompliance.

Return analysis (design §7 ReturnAnalysis) of the organizations' customer returns entered in the period (cancelled ones counted apart), by reason, product, response, customer, received status or month: returns, open returns, items, quantities requested (an open return counted as requested, never as credited), received, accepted, rejected, replaced and credited at the as-of time, and the amounts requested and credited per currency, withheld without PRICE_VIEW, ACCOUNTING_VIEW or RECEIVABLE_VIEW. Refuses as get#SlaCompliance, and CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE for a customer the user does not serve.

One customer's service measures (crosscut §3.2 CustomerServiceStatistics) over the last periodDays (90 by default), of the user's organizations' cases: open cases, failed service levels, the mean first response and resolution in business time, and the satisfaction answers' mean score, each with its denominator; no comment. Refuses CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE for a customer the user does not serve.

The customer's service agreements with the user's organizations (crosscut §3.2 ServiceAgreements; AgrService, P11's store#ServiceAgreement): period, status, whether it covers now, the products covered and the warranty terms; and whether the user may store one (SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT). Refuses CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE.
